subject: Foundry Labs — launch package + credit stacking exception
messages:
From: Emma Cole <emma@foundrylabs.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch package question — can promo credits stack with partner grant?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — the Foundry team liked the latency numbers and the cost projections. We’re kicking off a cohort for late-stage startups and want to include Redwood as the inference provider. Procurement asked me to confirm one detail before we proceed: our accelerator provides each cohort company a $10k partner grant (issued as an external voucher). Foundry is also eligible for Redwood’s launch promo (one-time $5k credits for new partners).

Can those two credits be combined for a single company, or do you treat the partner grant as the same promo family (i.e., non-stackable)? If they can stack, we may be able to move forward this month.

I’ve attached a draft SOW and our cohort sizing estimate for context.

Appreciate a quick note on the policy or an escalation path if this needs approval.

Best,
Emma
Emma Cole
Program Director — Foundry Labs
emma@foundrylabs.io
Attachment: Foundry_Labs_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emma Cole <emma@foundrylabs.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch package question — can promo credits stack with partner grant?

Hi Emma — thanks for the docs and good to hear the team liked the demo.

Short answer: by default our public promos don’t stack with partner grants because they’re handled as different promotional instruments that both impact initial invoice accounting. That said, we do make exceptions for strategic accelerator partners when the cohort program helps drive multiple new customer conversions.

I’m looping in Marissa (partnerships) and Ben (growth sales) to review a possible one-off carveout. To help speed review, could you confirm: 1) whether the $10k is applied per company (not pooled), 2) expected cohort size (companies using Redwood), and 3) any timing constraints for the credits (must be used within 90 days of issuance, etc.).

If you prefer, we can set a 30-minute call today to run through the numbers.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Attachment: pricing-comparison-2028.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Emma Cole <emma@foundrylabs.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2028 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch package question — can promo credits stack with partner grant?

Thanks Jonas — quick answers below and happy to hop on a call.

1) The $10k grant is issued per company in the cohort and lands as a voucher assigned to that company’s account.
2) We expect 12 companies to join the initial cohort and we expect 8 of them to use hosted inference from day one (the others are more experimental).
3) The grant expires 180 days after issuance; the Redwood promo would need to be usable within that window.

If a stacking exception is possible for those 8 committed teams, this accelerates our selection and budgeting process.

—Emma
Emma Cole
Program Director — Foundry Labs
Attachment: (none)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Cole <emma@foundrylabs.io>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch package question — can promo credits stack with partner grant?

Jonas / Marissa — quick decision from pricing: we can approve a limited stacking carveout for Foundry cohort companies under these conditions:

- Eligibility: stacking allowed only for cohort companies who 1) are new Redwood customers and 2) have their Foundry $10k voucher assigned directly to their Redwood account.
- Promo application: Redwood public launch promo ($5k) can be applied on top of the $10k grant for the first invoice; total promotional credit capped at $15k per company (we won’t issue >$15k in combined credits).
- Usage window: credits must be consumed within 150 days of issuance (Foundry grant and Redwood promo start dates must align to enable billing).
- Reporting: Foundry must provide a cohort roster and a signed MPA (mutual action plan) confirming companies targeted; Redwood will request cohort usage data after 60 days to validate conversion assumptions.
- Legal/Finance: Ben to coordinate a short addendum to the partner agreement and ensure accounting records the combined promotional treatment.

Emma — happy to finalize. If that works, I’ll get the addendum drafted and loop legal.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: partner-stacking-addendum-draft.docx (document)
